sourceText:
Mysterious Porcupine Balls
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Monday, October 17, 2011 - 9:50pm

Ingredients




1 cup raw rice
1 lb hamburger
1/2 cup bell pepper, diced
1/2 cup onion, diced
4 tsp Worcestershire sauce
1 quart spaghetti sauce
s/p to taste

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients except sauce. 2 Form 4 equal sized meatballs. 3 Place in oven proof dish. 4 Pour sauce over all. 5 Cover and bake at 350, until rice is cooked and meat if browned through. 6 Serve with good bread to mop up extra sauce, a nice veg on the side and coleslaw.

About

Just an old family recipe. I have no idea where it came from, before my mother made it. Easy and delicious, this makes 4 hearty porky balls...I double it for my family of 7 (6 of which are eaters + a baby nibbler). 
The name comes from the little pieces of rice sticking out every which way. What? What were YOU thinking?
